capabilities: Render an interactive mind-map of the vault's folders, files and links
Derive parent, child, friend and sibling relationships from links and tags
Read explicitly defined relationships from dataview fields and YAML frontmatter
Show lateral relationships (Other Friends) on the right side
disambiguation: Despite the Excalidraw-based name, it is not a drawing tool; it auto-generates a structured relationship map from vault links and fields.
extras: Detailed documentation is provided as YouTube walkthrough and demo videos rather than written usage instructions; the author accepts donations via Buy Me a Coffee.
intentEvidence: ExcaliBrain is built on top of Dataview and Excalidraw.
problem: Obsidian's graph view shows unstructured links, so it does not organize notes into hierarchical family-style relationships between notes.
